function.name: place_order

function.name: absolute_value

value.description: The number to compute the logarithm of.

function.name: multiply

function.name: percentage

function.name: si_unit_conversion

unit_out.description: Unit to convert the value to.

function.name: square_root

number.description: The number to calculate the square root of.

Science.output_description: The square root of the given number, calculated with the specified precision (number of decimal places) using the decimal module.

function.name: standard_deviation
function.description: Calculate the standard deviation of a list of numbers.

numbers.description: List of numbers to calculate the standard deviation of.

Science.output_description: The standard deviation of the provided list of numbers, returned as a floating-point value.

function.name: subtract

function.name: sum_values

function.name: cat
function.description: Display the contents of a file of any extension from currrent directory.

file_name.description: The name of the file from current directory to display. No path is allowed.

Storage.output_description: The contents of the specified file from the current directory, returned as a string.

function.name: cd
function.description: Change the current working directory to the specified folder.

folder.description: The folder of the directory to change to. You can only change one folder at a time.

Storage.output_description: A status message indicating the result of the directory change operation, such as confirmation of the new current directory on success or an error message if the specified folder does not exist.

function.name: cp
function.description: Copy a file or directory from one location to another.  If the destination is a directory, the source file or directory will be copied into the destination directory.  Both source and destination must be local to the current directory.

source.description: The name of the file or directory to copy.

destination.description: The destination name to copy the file or directory to. If the destination is a directory, the source will be copied into this directory. No file paths allowed.

Storage.output_description: A status message indicating the result of the copy operation, such as a success confirmation (e.g., 'File copied successfully') or an error message if the source does not exist, the destination is invalid, or the operation fails.

function.name: diff
function.description: Compare two files of any extension line by line at the current directory.

file_name1.description: The name of the first file in current directory.

file_name2.description: The name of the second file in current directorry.

Storage.output_description: A string containing the line-by-line differences between the two specified files, showing which lines are added, removed, or changed, similar to the output of a Unix diff command.

function.name: du
function.description: Estimate the disk usage of a directory and its contents.

human_readable.description: If True, returns the size in human-readable format (e.g., KB, MB).

Storage.output_description: The estimated disk usage of the specified directory and its contents. When human_readable is false (default), the output is a string representation of the size in bytes (e.g., '1024'). When human_readable is true, the output is a human-readable size string with appropriate units (e.g., '1KB', '2.5MB').

function.name: echo
function.description: Write content to a file at current directory or display it in the terminal.

content.description: The content to write or display.

file_name.description: The name of the file at current directory to write the content to. Defaults to None.

Storage.output_description: Either the content that was displayed in the terminal (when no file_name is provided) or a status message indicating the success of writing the content to the specified file.

function.name: find
function.description: Find any file or directories under specific path that contain name in its file name.  This method searches for files of any extension and directories within a specified path that match the given name. If no name is provided, it returns all files and directories in the specified path and its subdirectories. Note: This method performs a recursive search through all subdirectories of the given path.

path.description: The directory path to start the search. Defaults to the current directory (".").

name.description: The name of the file or directory to search for. If None, all items are returned.

Storage.output_description: A list of strings representing the paths of files and directories found under the specified path that match the given name (or all items if name is None). Each string is a relative path from the search root.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search for lines in a file of any extension at current directory that contain the specified pattern.

file_name.description: The name of the file to search. No path is allowed and you can only perform on file at local directory.

Storage.output_description: A list of strings, each representing a line from the specified file that contains the given pattern. If no lines match the pattern, an empty list is returned.

function.name: ls
function.description: List the contents of the current directory.

a.description: Show hidden files and directories. Defaults to False.

Storage.output_description: A list of strings representing the names of files and directories in the current directory. If the optional parameter 'a' is true, hidden files (those starting with '.') are also included in the list.

function.name: mkdir
function.description: Create a new directory in the current directory.

dir_name.description: The name of the new directory at current directory. You can only create directory at current directory.

Storage.output_description: A confirmation message indicating the result of the directory creation operation, such as 'Directory <dir_name> created successfully.' or an error message if the operation failed (e.g., directory already exists).

function.name: mv
function.description: Move a file or directory from one location to another. so

source.description: Source name of the file or directory to move. Source must be local to the current directory.

destination.description: The destination name to move the file or directory to. Destination must be local to the current directory and cannot be a path. If destination is not an existing directory like when renaming something, destination is the new file name.

Storage.output_description: A message indicating the result of the move operation, such as a success confirmation or an error description if the move failed.

function.name: rm
function.description: Remove a file or directory.

file_name.description: The name of the file or directory to remove.

Storage.output_description: True if the file or directory was successfully removed, False if the removal failed (e.g., file not found, permission denied, or other error).

function.name: rmdir
function.description: Remove a directory at current directory.

dir_name.description: The name of the directory to remove. Directory must be local to the current directory.

Storage.output_description: A message indicating the result of the rmdir operation, such as confirmation of successful removal or an error description if the directory could not be removed (e.g., not found, not empty, or permission denied).

function.name: sort
function.description: Sort the contents of a file line by line.

file_name.description: The name of the file appeared at current directory to sort.

Storage.output_description: The sorted contents of the specified file, with lines sorted lexicographically, returned as a single string where each line is separated by a newline character.

function.name: tail
function.description: Display the last part of a file of any extension.

file_name.description: The name of the file to display. No path is allowed and you can only perform on file at local directory.

lines.description: The number of lines to display from the end of the file. Defaults to 10.

Storage.output_description: The last 'lines' number of lines from the specified file, returned as a string with newline characters separating the lines. If the 'lines' parameter is not provided, the default is 10 lines.

function.name: touch
function.description: Create a new file of any extension in the current directory.

file_name.description: The name of the new file in the current directory. file_name is local to the current directory and does not allow path.

Storage.output_description: A confirmation message indicating the result of the touch operation, such as 'File created successfully.' or an error message if the file could not be created.

function.name: wc
function.description: Count the number of lines, words, and characters in a file of any extension from current directory.

file_name.description: Name of the file of current directory to perform wc operation on.

mode.description: Mode of operation ('l' for lines, 'w' for words, 'c' for characters).

Storage.output_description: The count of lines, words, or characters in the specified file, depending on the mode parameter. If mode is 'l' (default), returns the number of lines; if 'w', returns the number of words; if 'c', returns the number of characters.

function.name: get_budget_fiscal_year
function.description: Get the budget fiscal year

lastModifiedAfter.description: Use this field if you only want Fiscal Years that were changed after the supplied date. The supplied date will be interpreted in the UTC time zone. If lastModifiedAfter is not supplied, the service will return all Fiscal Years, regardless of modified date. Example: 2016-03-29T16:12:20. Return in the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

The list includes only those fiscal years that match the optional filters (lastModifiedAfter and includeRemoved); if no filters are provided, all fiscal years are returned.
